national.title: 53 Jemaah Umrah Boyolali Terdampar di Bangkok, Biro Diduga Ilegal
national.summary: Sebanyak 53 jemaah umrah dari Boyolali terjebak di Bangkok setelah ditipu biro ilegal. Mereka menunggu pengembalian dana dan satu jemaah dirawat di ICU.

national.title: Cerita Warga Petukangan Jaksel soal TK Kerap Banjir Meski Tak Hujan Besar
national.summary: Wilayah Petukangan Utara, Pesanggrahan, Jakarta Selatan (Jaksel) dilanda banjir sejak kemarin. Salah satu yang terdampak ialah bangunan TK.

international.title: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock
international.summary: Countries from nearly 200 countries are in a deadlock to try and get a new global climate agreement.

international.title: Emergency crews in Ukraine hit by a double-tap strike
international.summary: Video shows emergency crews in Ukraine approaching the scene of a Russian strike, before another strike hits.

international.title: Campaigners back call for scrutiny of consent laws by Joanne Young
international.summary: Experts say no law states third-party consent is a valid defence and call for public debate and further education Campaigners have welcomed a call for scrutiny of consent laws by a survivor of drug-facilitated rape but said action must also focus on wider issues around sexual assault. Joanne Young , who was drugged and raped by her husband and sexually abused by men he invited into their home, warned of “serious questions about how the law deals with consent”. Continue reading...
